Apply one named wrong implementation from a brief: one find → replace in one file, with a copy and a record in .construct/mutations/ (mutate apply)

USAGE mutate apply [OPTIONS] 

OPTIONS

    --dir=<dir>    Target directory (Default: .)                                                                      
        --plain    No colors, no lore (CI-friendly) (Default: false)                                                  
       --johnny    Wake up, Netrunner. (Default: false)                                                               
  --from=<from>    The file carrying the mutation lines (M<id> | file | find: `old` → `new` | red: <test> | `message`)
      --id=<id>    The id of the mutation line to apply                                                               
         --json    Machine-readable report (Default: false)
